research_question: Within a geometry-feasible pose set, does frozen-policy success vary, and how much headroom remains between the strongest geometry-only selection and a sampled empirical policy oracle?

main_definitions.p_train: Audited demonstration SE(2) medoid, transformed to the scene using the same contact-point/fixture-yaw coordinate contract.
main_definitions.p_geom: Maximum fixed geometric score in the geometry-feasible sampled pool; selected before either pose is executed.
main_definitions.p_oracle: Post-hoc empirical best pose within the rollout-labelled sample of the geometry-feasible pool; discovery and validation seeds are independent.
main_definitions.p_mobipi: Optional audited Mobi-pi selector output, reported when present in the pose registry.
main_definitions.H_geom: S_val(p_oracle) - S_val(p_geom), signed and measured using paired validation seeds.

candidate_protocol.generation: 0.10 m floor grid with target-facing headings plus training-pose local samples; no radial hard cutoff.
candidate_protocol.rollout_search: Only for GT-basin construction and p_oracle discovery; never used by p_geom.

geometry.calibration: Reviewed geom/site-local contact point, outward approach normal and full EEF target rotation, resolved on the current asset.
geometry.hard_feasibility: Base footprint valid, no initial blocking robot collision, rendered target visibility at least 0.50, and near-contact positional IK residual at most 0.08 m.
geometry.diagnostics: Four sequential pre-contact 6D IK poses, orientation residuals, joint margins, manipulability, contact alignment, and joint-interpolation collision checks. Strict trajectory success is not a hard gate.
geometry.scope: Relaxed geometric reachability plus continuous approach-quality diagnostics; no guarantee of complete actuation or global IK completeness.
geometry.score: Per-scene min-max equal-weight score over target distance, depth-patch visibility, joint margin, position residual, rotation residual, contact alignment, and full-Jacobian manipulability.

evaluation.old_result_compatibility: Reject pre-v7 and unversioned validation CSV files.
evaluation.runtime_error: Abort shard; never count as policy failure.

gate_decision.interpretation: Primary evidence is the rollout-labelled G(p) versus S_pi(p) sample and its mixed basin membership. H_geom summarizes policy-specific headroom against the strongest fixed geometry-only baseline. The empirical oracle is limited to the sampled geometry-feasible poses.
